# Step - key

`key` · category: [Values and properties](../../traversal/step_reference.md#values-and-properties)

Yields the key of each property.

## Forms

```text
key()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).properties().key().to_list()   // ["name", "age"]
```
